    while (a != 0) {
        T t = m / a;
        m -= t * a; swap(a, m);
        u -= t * v; swap(u, v);
    }

template<typename T> T mod_inverse(T a, T m) {
    T u = 0, v = 1;
    while (a != 0) {
        T t = m / a;
        m -= t * a; swap(a, m);
        u -= t * v; swap(u, v);
    }
    assert(m == 1);
    return u;
}

template<typename T> class Modular {
public:

    constexpr Modular() : value() {}

    template<typename U> static Type normalize(const U& x) {
        Type v;
        if (-mod() <= x && x < mod()) v = static_cast<Type>(x);
        else v = static_cast<Type>(x % mod());
        if (v < 0) v += mod();
        return v;
    }
    
    const Type& operator()() const { return value; }
    template<typename U> explicit operator U() const { return static_cast<U>(value); }

    template<typename U> Modular& operator+=(const U& other) { return *this += Modular(other); }
    template<typename U> Modular& operator-=(const U& other) { return *this -= Modular(other); }

    Modular operator--(int) { Modular result(*this); *this -= 1; return result; }
    Modular operator-() const { return Modular(-value); }
    
    template<typename U = T> typename enable_if<is_same<typename Modular<U>::Type, int>::value, Modular>::type& operator*=(const Modular& rhs) {
#ifdef _WIN32

        uint32_t xh = static_cast<uint32_t>(x >> 32), xl = static_cast<uint32_t>(x), d, m;
        asm("divl %4; \n\t" : "=a" (d), "=d" (m) : "d" (xh), "a" (xl), "r" (mod()));

        return *this;
    }
    template<typename U = T> typename enable_if<is_same<typename Modular<U>::Type, int64_t>::value, Modular>::type& operator*=(const Modular& rhs) {
        int64_t q = static_cast<int64_t>(static_cast<long double>(value) * rhs.value / mod());

    }
    template<typename U = T> typename enable_if<!is_integral<typename Modular<U>::Type>::value, Modular>::type& operator*=(const Modular& rhs) {
        value = normalize(value * rhs.value);
        return *this;
    }
    
    Modular& operator/=(const Modular& other) { return *this *= Modular(mod_inverse(other.value, mod())); }
    
    template<typename U> friend bool operator==(const Modular<U>& lhs, const Modular<U>& rhs);

};

template<typename T, typename U> Modular<T> mod_pow(const Modular<T>& a, const U& b) {
    assert(b >= 0);
    Modular<T> x = a, res = 1;
    U p = b;
    while (p > 0) {
        if (p & 1) res *= x;
        x *= x;
        p >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}
